name: DiffuSpace Clover-35B-A3B launch blog (benchmark figures)
notes: Fetched 2026-10-29. This is where Clover's numbers actually live - the HF card carries only a link to it. Two benchmark figures were downloaded and transcribed: https://diffuspace.ai/assets/blog/clover/agentic-benchmarks.jpg (1,364,784 B) and https://diffuspace.ai/assets/blog/clover/general-benchmarks.jpg (tabular, 17 rows, columns Clover-35B-A3B-Preview and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Both were read with tools/read_figures.py: the agentic figure through nous-portal-main/ornith/ornith-1.5-122b:free, the general figure through opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash after ornith returned HTTP 500 twice and cap/vision returned 404 model_not_routed for gemini-3.8-flash. The two runs agree internally (agentic: tau3 65.3, BFCL-v4 67.9, T-Bench 2.1 51.7, Terminal-Hard 38.1, SWE-bench Verified 73.6, SWE-Pro 46.5) and the blog's Chinese prose independently states SWE-bench Verified 73.6, Terminal-Bench 2.1 51.7, tau3 Overall 65.3, GPQA Diamond 83.8, ZebraLogic 95.8, AA-LCR 72.0, MMLU-Pro 84.8, BFCL-v4 67.9, tau3 Banking 14.4 - so every number used in the record is corroborated in prose, not figure-only. CAVEAT: no harness, no sampling settings and no per-row thinking level are printed anywhere, and the figures have no error bars. The blog also states throughput (680 tok/s GB300 BF16 batch 1; 515 tok/s H200 vs 365 tok/s DFlash2; 101.8 tok/s INT4 on an RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB) which is vendor-measured speed, not a benchmark row. Per AGENTS.md this is a blog kind with no separately published primary table, so lower confidence than a spec sheet.
